Tooltip_DanTraits_Inhaler:
Rescue inhaler.
Treats: asthma attacks and airway irritation.
Dose: one puff when your airway tightens.
Works at once, halving the irritation.
Side effects: your heart races for a moment,
and a diabetic's blood sugar rises a little.
Too many puffs close together: shakes and a racing heart,
hard on a weak heart.
10 puffs.
Tooltip_DanTraits_InsulinPen:
Rapid-acting insulin.
Treats: diabetes (Type 1 needs it).
Dose: one dose lowers blood sugar by about 50 over four hours,
starting after fifteen minutes.
Side effects: too much drops blood sugar dangerously low.
40 doses.
Tooltip_DanTraits_DiaParts2: Too much sugar at once: eat half at a time
Tooltip_DanTraits_DiaParts3: Too much sugar at once: eat a third at a time
Tooltip_DanTraits_DiaParts4: Too much sugar at once: eat a quarter at a time
Tooltip_DanTraits_DiaParts5: Too much sugar at once: eat a little at a time
Tooltip_Recipe_DanTraitsInsulinDosing: Counting carbohydrates and dosing insulin to match. With Type 1 diabetes, a food's tooltip gives the exact doses it takes, and the glucose meter says what it takes to bring blood sugar back to normal.
Tooltip_DanTraits_GlucoseMeter: Reads blood sugar from a drop of blood. Needs test strips.
Tooltip_DanTraits_TestStrips: For a glucose meter. One strip per reading. 25 strips.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Metformin:
Daily diabetes pill.
Treats: Type 2 diabetes.
Dose: one pill a day. Builds up over 2 days,
then lowers insulin resistance. Missed days let it fade.
Side effects: now and then, an upset stomach.
Too many at once: nausea.
30 pills.
Tooltip_DanTraits_NoSyringe: No insulin syringe to draw it up with.
Tooltip_DanTraits_InsulinVial:
Rapid-acting insulin, the same as a pen's.
Needs an insulin syringe to inject.
Dose: one dose lowers blood sugar by about 50 over four hours,
starting after fifteen minutes.
Side effects: too much drops blood sugar dangerously low.
40 doses.
Tooltip_DanTraits_InsulinSyringe: For drawing up insulin from a vial. Kept and reused.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Pancreas: Raw organ meat. Fresh and uncooked, it can be made into a vial of insulin (The Insulin Papers). Spoils fast: keep it cold.
Tooltip_DanTraits_PancreasSmall: From a small or young animal. Four, fresh and uncooked, make a vial of insulin (The Insulin Papers). Spoils fast: keep it cold.
Tooltip_Recipe_DanTraitsExtractInsulin: The 1922 method: mince a fresh, raw pancreas, soak it in alcohol with vinegar, strain it through a clean rag. Makes a 40-dose vial of insulin. First Aid 2; First Aid 8 knows it without the magazine.
Tooltip_Recipe_DanTraitsExtractInsulinSm: The same extraction from four small pancreases (rabbits, raccoons, young animals). Makes a 40-dose vial of insulin.
Tooltip_DanTraits_NotDiabetic: You have no reason to take this.
Tooltip_DanTraits_IronPills:
Iron supplement.
Treats: anaemia.
Dose: one a day to build your iron back up.
Side effects: now and then, mild nausea.
30 pills.
Tooltip_DanTraits_NicotineGum:
Nicotine gum.
Treats: cigarette cravings (Smoker).
Dose: chew a piece when a craving hits. Takes most of the edge off at once.
Quitting still takes three weeks without tobacco.
Side effects: now and then, hiccups and a queasy stomach.
Too many at once: nausea and dizziness.
10 pieces.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Anticonvulsants:
Daily epilepsy pill.
Treats: epilepsy.
Dose: one pill every 12 hours. Builds up over 5 days,
then makes seizures far less likely. Missed doses let it fade.
Side effects: now and then, drowsiness.
Too many at once: heavy and sluggish.
30 pills.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Sunblock: Rub it in and the sun can't burn bare skin for 8 hours. Does nothing for a burn you already have. 8 coats.
Tooltip_DanTraits_ClottingPowder:
Styptic powder for a bleeding wound.
Use: right-click the bleeding part in the health panel, dressing off.
A scratch or cut: stops it bleeding.
A deep wound: bleeds at a quarter for 12 hours. Still needs stitches.
Dress it after. Stings. Barely helps with glass or a bullet still in.
5 uses.
Tooltip_DanTraits_ClotBandaged: Take the dressing off first: the powder goes into the wound.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Prednisone:
Steroid for flares.
Treats: multiple sclerosis flares, arthritis flares.
Dose: one a day during a flare. Works at once:
an MS flare passes three times as fast; an arthritis flare
is cut to a third while it lasts. Does nothing between flares.
While taking it: increased hunger.
Side effects: now and then, restless and on edge.
Too many at once: wired and ravenous.
20 pills.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Baclofen:
Muscle relaxant.
Treats: muscle stiffness and spasms from multiple sclerosis,
including stiffness brought on by heat. Dose: one every 12 hours.
Builds up over 2 days, then halves the stiffness. Missed doses let it fade.
For anyone: a strain, a pulled muscle or a bad back. One works for
about 12 hours: stiffness fades twice as fast, a pulled muscle and
a bad back hurt about half as much. It eases them; it does not heal them faster.
While taking it: mild drowsiness, far drowsier with a drink.
Training on it (without MS): less experience, easier to pull a muscle.
Side effects: now and then, weak muscles and slow stamina.
Too many at once: limp and barely awake.
30 pills.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Amantadine:
MS fatigue pill.
Treats: multiple sclerosis fatigue.
Dose: one every 12 hours. Builds up over 3 days,
then every morning starts with two more spoons. Missed doses let it fade.
While taking it: dry mouth (a little thirstier).
Side effects: now and then, mild nausea.
Too many at once: jittery and confused.
30 pills.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Diazepam:
Anti-anxiety pill.
Treats: panic and anxiety.
Dose: one pill calms panic quickly, for about an hour and a half.
Side effects: now and then, drowsiness.
Too many at once: you can barely keep your eyes open.
20 pills.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Sumatriptan:
Migraine pill.
Treats: migraine attacks (ordinary painkillers barely touch them).
Dose: one pill. During the aura, the attack to come is half as bad;
during an attack, it is over within two hours. Once per attack.
After: heavy and a little clumsy for a day.
Too many at once: chest tightness and jitters.
6 tablets.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Cyclobenzaprine:
Muscle relaxant. Works as baclofen does for a strain,
a pulled muscle or a bad back: one works for about 12 hours,
stiffness fades twice as fast, a pulled muscle and a bad back
hurt about half as much. Drowsy, far drowsier with a drink.
Training on it: less experience, easier to pull a muscle.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Nitroglycerin:
Heart rescue tablet.
Treats: chest pain (angina).
Dose: one under the tongue. The pain is gone within a minute
and the strain on the heart halves. After: half an hour of headache.
Two within an hour: your blood pressure drops and you faint.
25 tablets.
Tooltip_DanTraits_PillsBeta:
Daily heart pill.
Treats: Heart Condition.
Dose: one pill a day. Builds up over 3 days,
then strain builds half as fast and a heart attack is half as likely.
While built up, stamina comes back a tenth slower. Missed days let it fade. Does not calm panic (that is diazepam).
Side effects: now and then, stamina comes back slower.
Too many at once: dizziness and fainting.
30 pills.
Tooltip_DanTraits_PillsAntiDep:
Daily antidepressant.
Treats: depression (Major Depressive Disorder). For anyone else, lifts mood over time.
Dose: one pill a day. Builds up over 3 days.
Stopping suddenly after a week or more brings a few rough days.
Side effects: now and then, queasiness.
30 pills.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Painkillers:
Painkillers.
Treats: pain, including headaches and gut flares.
Arthritis: a flare is halved while they work.
Only dull a hangover (half as long). Barely touch a migraine.
Dose: one or two pills. Work for a few hours.
Side effects: now and then, an upset stomach.
Four or more at once: strong nausea.
Tooltip_DanTraits_SleepingTablets:
Sleeping tablets.
Treats: trouble sleeping.
Dose: one at bedtime helps you fall asleep
and sleep through light that would wake you.
Side effects: drowsiness, and now and then groggy the next day.
Too many at once: very deep sleep, and you may black out.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Vitamins:
Caffeine pills.
Treats: tiredness.
Dose: one gives a burst of energy.
Counts as caffeine, so it eases caffeine withdrawal.
Side effects: a little stress,
and light wakes you more easily for a few hours.
Too many at once: jitters and stress, hard on a weak heart.
Tooltip_DanTraits_PillCaddy:
Weekly pill organiser.
Holds medication only.
Hangs on the belt like a canteen.
Holds more if you are Organized.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Washboard: Carry it and hand washing gets clothes cleaner, at the cost of a longer scrub.
Tooltip_DanTraits_FabricProtector: Spray a garment and it keeps only half of the blood and dirt that lands on it, for about three washes. 5 garments.
Tooltip_DanTraits_FabricWax: Rub it into a garment and it keeps only half of the blood and dirt that lands on it, for about three washes. 4 garments.
Tooltip_DanTraits_DryerSheets: Right-click a dryer to put one in with the load. Everything it dries smells clean for longer once worn: half as fast to go stale, until its next wash. 20 sheets.
Tooltip_DanTraits_ClotheslineBuild: A pulley clothesline five squares long from here: a post, three squares of line, a post. Uses two long sticks, planks or saplings and two rope, twine, sheet strips, denim strips or wire. Each post holds 15. Damp clothes dry fast in sun, wind and warmth, slowly at night or in the cold, and the rain soaks them again. Daylight airs out a little staleness.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Musty: Musty: stayed damp too long, needs a wash
Tooltip_DanTraits_DampHours: Damp: musty in about %1 h unless dried
Tooltip_DanTraits_Stain: Set-in stain: only bleach gets it out
Tooltip_DanTraits_LineBlocked: Needs five clear squares of floor in a row.
Tooltip_DanTraits_SensoryRefuse: Overloaded: only a safe food will go down.
Tooltip_DanTraits_FitStrained: A pulled muscle in the %1. Give it time.
Tooltip_DanTraits_CookRaw: Cook it for a meal bonus
Tooltip_DanTraits_CookDiet_bulk: Eat more than you burn: while you are putting on weight, Strength experience +10%%.
Tooltip_DanTraits_CookDiet_cut: Eat less than you burn: while you are losing weight, Fitness experience +10%% and the weight comes off a quarter faster.
Tooltip_Recipe_DanTraitsFitUpperLower: The Upper/Lower training plan. Once read, all Strength experience +10%%.
Tooltip_Recipe_DanTraitsFitPPL: The Push Pull Legs training plan. Once read, all Strength experience +10%%.
Tooltip_Recipe_DanTraitsFitRun: The First Five Miles running plan. Once read, all Fitness experience +10%%.
Tooltip_Recipe_DanTraitsFitStrongman: The Strongman training plan: carrying heavy things. Once read, all Strength and Fitness experience +5%%.
Tooltip_Recipe_DanTraitsFitLimber: The Active Recovery plan. Once read, all Fitness experience +10%% and muscles recover 10%% faster.
Tooltip_DanTraits_NCHeadphones: Worn, they shut out every sound: you hear nothing at all, zombies included, until you take them off. With Sensory Issues, no noise gets through.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Hwb_hot: Hot: about %1 more, then warm. Hold it on sore muscles.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Hwb_warm: Warm: about %1 more. Hold it on sore muscles.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Hwb_tepid: Tepid: too cool to help. Heat it again.
Tooltip_DanTraits_HwbCold: Cold. Heat it on a stove, in a microwave or by a fire to soothe sore muscles.
Tooltip_DanTraits_HwbEmpty: Fill it with water and heat it to soothe sore muscles.
Tooltip_DanTraits_AdrenalineInjector:
Adrenaline, one shot into the thigh. For emergencies only.
For two hours: no tiredness, full stamina that comes back faster,
a pounding heart, stress and shaking hands.
Then the crash: the tiredness comes back, and more,
with low mood, a headache and slow stamina for hours.
A 1 in 4 chance of a heart attack, sometime in the first 40 minutes.
Each shot within a day adds another 1 in 4.
Beta blockers blunt it: less lift, less risk.
